title: Payments for trips you rented

scope.title: This is money you paid to the shop
scope.body: Reservation transfers to XePrime appear inside each trip. Money XePrime owes you is in your

depositNote: A security deposit paid to the shop is returned when you bring the vehicle back, less any charges. It is not money lost.

notes.title: Before adding a payout account:
notes.holder: Account holder: the beneficiary name must match the name registered with your bank exactly — otherwise the bank returns the transfer.
notes.timing: When money arrives: XePrime transfers within {days, plural, one {# business day} other {# business days}} of approving a withdrawal.
notes.accountType: Account type: only Vietnamese bank accounts are supported. Transfers cannot go to credit cards or e-wallets.
notes.change: Changing accounts: withdrawals already requested still go to the account chosen when they were sent.
